name: Student Performance Factors
description: Survey of 6,607 students linking study habits, home background, school environment and wellbeing to their final exam score.
table_description: One row per student: study habits, family background, school factors and their exam score.

columns.name: hours_studied
columns.label: hours studied
columns.description: Hours the student spends studying each week.

columns.name: attendance
columns.label: attendance
columns.description: Percentage of classes attended.

columns.name: parental_involvement
columns.label: parental involvement
columns.description: How involved parents are in the student's education (Low, Medium, High).

columns.name: access_to_resources
columns.label: access to resources
columns.description: Availability of educational resources (Low, Medium, High).

columns.name: extracurricular_activities
columns.label: extracurricular activities
columns.description: Whether the student takes part in extracurricular activities (Yes/No).

columns.name: sleep_hours
columns.label: sleep hours
columns.description: Average hours of sleep per night.

columns.name: previous_scores
columns.label: previous scores
columns.description: Scores from previous exams (out of 100).

columns.name: motivation_level
columns.label: motivation level
columns.description: Student's level of motivation (Low, Medium, High).

columns.name: internet_access
columns.label: internet access
columns.description: Whether the student has internet access (Yes/No).

columns.name: tutoring_sessions
columns.label: tutoring sessions
columns.description: Number of tutoring sessions attended per month.

columns.name: family_income
columns.label: family income
columns.description: Family income level (Low, Medium, High). Sensitive — restricted for Insights Users by default.

columns.name: teacher_quality
columns.label: teacher quality
columns.description: Quality of the student's teachers (Low, Medium, High).

columns.name: school_type
columns.label: school type
columns.description: Type of school attended (Public, Private).

columns.name: peer_influence
columns.label: peer influence
columns.description: Influence of peers on academic performance (Positive, Neutral, Negative).

columns.name: physical_activity
columns.label: physical activity
columns.description: Hours of physical activity per week.

columns.name: learning_disabilities
columns.label: learning disabilities
columns.description: Whether the student has a learning disability (Yes/No). Sensitive — restricted for Insights Users by default.

columns.name: parental_education_level
columns.label: parental education level
columns.description: Highest education level of the parents (High School, College, Postgraduate).

columns.name: distance_from_home
columns.label: distance from home
columns.description: Distance from home to school (Near, Moderate, Far).

columns.name: gender
columns.label: gender
columns.description: Student's gender (Male, Female).

columns.name: exam_score
columns.label: exam score
columns.description: Final exam score (out of 100).
